title: Landed-Cost Calculator
summary: A browser tool I built to turn shipping, fees, and resale prices into landed cost and break-even estimates.
question: What will an item actually cost by the time it reaches the buyer?

symbol.name: sigma
symbol.meaning: the sum of every cost between the seller and the buyer.

sections.title: Why I built it
sections.text: I started a resale shop in 2022 with $25 and filled more than 600 orders while I ran it. I kept recalculating the same costs across items and shipping options. I built a JavaScript calculator that takes product and shipping costs, fees, and package measurements and gives me a per-item estimate and a break-even price.

sections.title: A detail that mattered
sections.text: A light package can be expensive to ship if it takes up a lot of space. Comparing actual and dimensional weight makes that visible. The calculator keeps line rates editable so I can enter a current quote and compare scenarios.
